faqs.q: What is the difference between a habitable attic and storage?
faqs.a: A habitable room meets Building Regulations: an escape window of at least 450 mm each way and 0.33 m², a protected stair with FD20 doors, interconnected mains smoke alarms and stair headroom of at least 1.9 m at the centre and 1.8 m at the sides. Attics that fall short are sold as storage, and that can cause problems when the house is sold.

faqs.q: Do I need planning permission for a dormer?
faqs.a: Rear and side dormers may be exempt up to 30 m³ if they are no higher than the ridge and set back at least 20 cm from the eaves. Front dormers still need permission. We check your house first, and a Section 5 declaration gives certainty.

faqs.q: Can I put rooflights on the front of the house?
faqs.a: Up to two front rooflights of 100 by 90 cm may be exempt under Class 1C.

faqs.q: Can you fit an en-suite in the attic?
faqs.a: Yes. We have built attic en-suites under rooflights, including one in Rathcoole designed in 3D first.
An external engineer. We build to the engineer's design and bring one in if you do not have one.

faqs.q: Do you work in my area?
faqs.a: We work within 50 km of Dunshaughlin, Co. Meath. That covers all of Dublin and towns in Meath, Kildare, Louth (such as Drogheda) and north Wicklow.

sections.title: Habitable or storage
paragraphs: Attics that fall short of the regulations are sold as "storage", and that can cause problems when the house is sold. A habitable attic room needs:
bullets: An escape window of at least 450 mm each way and 0.33 m²
A protected stair with FD20 doors
Headroom over the stair of at least 1.9 m at the centre and 1.8 m at the sides

sections.title: Dormers and rooflights: the 2026 rules
paragraphs: A dormer or rooflights may be exempt if they meet all the conditions; we check your house first. For certainty, you can ask the council for a Section 5 declaration.
bullets: Rear and side dormers up to 30 m³ (Class 1B)
No higher than the ridge, and set back at least 20 cm from the eaves
Up to two front rooflights of 100 by 90 cm (Class 1C)
Front dormers still need planning permission
